nodes.title: SG-3.4 · Frontend type-checks and entry point resolves
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend holds the Vite React app (index.html -> src/main.tsx -> src/App.tsx). `npx tsc --noEmit` in game/frontend currently reports 3 errors, all in tests/layout.test.tsx (node:fs, node:path and process cannot be resolved because @types/node is not installed or configured). App render tests already exist in tests/app.test.tsx. Desired behavior: type-check is clean and the entry point is proven to resolve to App. Why: SG-3 playable frontend must be assembled and verifiable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/frontend, when `npx tsc --noEmit` runs, then it exits 0 with no errors
- Given index.html, when its module script src is read, then it is /src/main.tsx and that file exists and renders App into #root
- Given the App component, when rendered in a test, then the intro screen shows and Begin reveals the game view


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/package.json
- In scope: game/frontend/tsconfig.json
- In scope: game/frontend/src/main.tsx
- In scope: new unit tests for entry and typecheck config
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: New gameplay or UI features
- Out of scope: Rewriting existing App tests
- Preserve: Existing App, layout, scene and story tests
- Preserve: Existing src/App.tsx behavior


## Technical constraints
- Keep React 18, Vite 5, Vitest 2, strict TypeScript
- No API or backend changes


## Definition of done
- tsc --noEmit exits 0
- All frontend unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Frontend tsc --noEmit passes with Node test types
nodes.body:
Context: tests/layout.test.tsx imports node:fs and node:path and uses process.cwd(), but tsconfig types is ["vite/client","vitest/globals"] and @types/node is not installed, giving TS2307/TS2591. Desired behavior: tsc --noEmit is clean. Expected result: zero type errors. Why: type-check is a gate for the assembled frontend.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given package.json, when devDependencies are read, then @types/node is listed
- Given tsconfig.json, when compilerOptions.types is read, then it includes "node" alongside "vite/client" and "vitest/globals"
- Given game/frontend, when tsc --noEmit runs, then no TS2307 or TS2591 errors remain


## Scope
- In scope: Add @types/node devDependency
- In scope: Add node to tsconfig types
- Out of scope: Changing test logic in layout.test.tsx
- Preserve: strict mode
- Preserve: @game/* path alias


## Technical constraints
- Do not loosen strict or skipLibCheck settings


## Definition of done
- tsc --noEmit reports 0 errors


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Entry point resolves to App and is covered by a render test
nodes.body:
Context: index.html loads /src/main.tsx, which calls createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />) with a non-null assertion that gives an opaque error if #root is absent. Desired behavior: main.tsx fails with a clear message when #root is missing and mounts App otherwise; tests prove the chain index.html -> main.tsx -> App renders. Why: entry point must resolve.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given index.html, when read, then it has a div#root and a module script with src /src/main.tsx
- Given a document with #root, when main.tsx is imported, then createRoot is called with that element and render receives the App element
- Given a document without #root, when main.tsx is imported, then it throws an error whose message is 'Root element #root not found'
- Given App rendered in a test, when no interaction occurs, then the intro Begin button is shown


## Scope
- In scope: Guard in src/main.tsx
- In scope: New entry unit tests
- Out of scope: Changing App.tsx
- Preserve: Import of ./styles.css
- Preserve: Default export App


## Technical constraints
- Keep createRoot from react-dom/client


## Definition of done
- Entry tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: Unit tests for index.html, main.tsx mount and guard, and App render
nodes.description: Test the entry chain with react-dom/client mocked.
acceptance_criteria: index.html has div#root and script /src/main.tsx
main.tsx calls createRoot with #root and renders App
main.tsx throws when #root is missing
App renders the Begin button
technical_constraints: Mock react-dom/client with vi.mock; no real server

steps.action:
Create file with '// @vitest-environment jsdom'. vi.mock('react-dom/client', () => ({ createRoot: vi.fn(() => ({ render: vi.fn() })) })). Test 1 reads index.html via readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'index.html'),'utf8') and expects it to contain 'id="root"' and 'src="/src/main.tsx"', and existsSync of src/main.tsx true. Test 2: vi.resetModules, set document.body.innerHTML='
', await import('../src/main'), expect createRoot toHaveBeenCalledWith the #root element and the render mock toHaveBeenCalledOnce. Test 3: set body empty, vi.resetModules, expect(import('../src/main')).rejects.toThrow('Root element #root not found'). Test 4: render() and expect screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Begin'}) in the document.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/entry.test.tsx
